Responsible use

RoTorrent is a neutral tool for managing BitTorrent transfers. You are responsible for what you download and share. Only use it for material you have the right to distribute or obtain, and follow the laws where you live.

Privacy

This website has no analytics, trackers or cookies. Your theme choice is stored only in your own browser (localStorage). Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which means Google receives your IP address when the page loads.
